```{r}
small_fig<-function(GG){
  GG+theme(axis.title = element_text(size=8),
           axis.text = element_text(size=6),
           plot.title=element_text(size=8),
           legend.text = element_text(size=8),
           legend.key.size = unit(0.5,"line"))
}


make_hover_text <- function(df, exclude = c("x","y"), collapse = "<br>") {
  # ensure df is a data.frame
  df <- as.data.frame(df)
  cols <- setdiff(colnames(df), exclude)
  # create safe character representation for each cell
  cell_str <- function(x) {
    # avoid factors
    if (is.factor(x)) x <- as.character(x)
    # convert NA to string
    ifelse(is.na(x), "<i>NA</i>", as.character(x))
  }
  # build per-row html
  hover <- apply(df[ , cols, drop = FALSE], 1, function(row) {
    paste0(paste0(cols, ": ", cell_str(row)), collapse = collapse)
  })
  hover
}


prepare_tax_df<-function(PHYLOSEQ,RANK,Unass.symbol=NA,Unass.repl,
                         min_prop,top_tax,bellow_top,
                         merge_categories,prop.trans,sort_abu){
if(prop.trans==T){PHYLOSEQ=transform_sample_counts(PHYLOSEQ,function(x) x/sum(x))}
TT<-tax_table(PHYLOSEQ)
class(TT)<-"matrix"
TT[is.na(tax_table(TT))]<-Unass.repl
TT<-tax_table(TT)
tax_table(PHYLOSEQ)<-TT

PHYLOSEQ.merged<-tax_glom(PHYLOSEQ,taxrank=RANK)
PHYLOSEQ.merged=transform_sample_counts(PHYLOSEQ.merged,function(x) x/sum(x))

#select top taxa
NAMES<-as.character(tax_table(PHYLOSEQ.merged)[,RANK])
TS<-taxa_sums(PHYLOSEQ.merged)
names(TS)<-NAMES
TS<-rev(sort(TS))
KEEP<-names(TS)[1:top_tax]

#
TT<-tax_table(PHYLOSEQ.merged)
class(TT)<-"matrix"
TT[,RANK][!TT[,RANK]%in%KEEP]<-bellow_top
TT<-tax_table(TT)
tax_table(PHYLOSEQ.merged)<-TT
PHYLOSEQ.merged<-tax_glom(PHYLOSEQ.merged,taxrank=RANK)

mdf = psmelt(PHYLOSEQ.merged)

if(sort_abu==T){
  mdf[,RANK]<-as.factor(mdf[,RANK])
  ADD<-levels(mdf[,RANK])[!levels(mdf[,RANK])%in%KEEP]
  if(length(ADD)>0){mdf[,RANK]<-factor(mdf[,RANK],levels=c(KEEP,ADD))}
  if(length(ADD)==0){mdf[,RANK]<-factor(mdf[,RANK],levels=c(KEEP))}
}

mdf
}




```

```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=16}

library(MicrobiomeStat)

PHS.g_H.nR<-prune_samples(sample_data(PHS.pic_path)$Tribe.2%in%c("Hydromyini","native Rattini"),PHS.pic_path)
PHS.g_H.iR<-prune_samples(sample_data(PHS.pic_path)$Tribe.2%in%c("Hydromyini","invasive Rattini"),PHS.pic_path)
PHS.g_iR.nR<-prune_samples(sample_data(PHS.pic_path)$Tribe.2%in%c("invasive Rattini","native Rattini"),PHS.pic_path)

PHS.g_H.nR.t<-transform_sample_counts(PHS.g_H.nR,function(x) x/sum(x))
PHS.g_H.iR.t<-transform_sample_counts(PHS.g_H.iR,function(x) x/sum(x))
PHS.g_iR.nR.t<-transform_sample_counts(PHS.g_iR.nR,function(x) x/sum(x))


###################
# Hydro x Native R#
###################
#PHS.g_H.nR<-transform_sample_counts(PHS.g_H.nR,function(x) x/sum(x))
taxa_table<-data.frame(t(otu_table(PHS.g_H.nR.t)))
metadata<-data.frame(sample_data(PHS.g_H.nR.t))

class(taxa_table)<-"data.frame"
class(metadata)<-"data.frame"

rownames(taxa_table)<-sample_names(PHS.g_H.nR.t)
rownames(metadata)<-sample_names(PHS.g_H.nR.t)

metadata$Tribe.2<-as.factor(metadata$Tribe.2)
metadata$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others<-as.factor(metadata$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others)
metadata$Run<-as.factor(metadata$Run)
metadata$Locality<-as.factor(metadata$Locality)

Linda_H.nR.G<-
  linda(
    feature.dat=t(as.matrix(taxa_table)),
    meta.dat=metadata,
    formula="~Run+Tribe.2+(1|Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others)+(1|Locality)",
    feature.dat.type = c('proportion'),
    prev.filter = 0.1,
    mean.abund.filter = 0.0001, 
    max.abund.filter = 0,
    is.winsor = F,
    outlier.pct = 0.03,
    adaptive = TRUE,
    zero.handling = c('pseudo-count', 'imputation'),
    pseudo.cnt = 0.5,
    corr.cut = 0.1,
    p.adj.method = "BH",
    alpha = 0.05,
    n.cores = 1, 
    verbose = TRUE
  )
```

# Correlation of resulting log2 fold changes 


```{r}
RN<-c(rownames(RES_H.nR.G),rownames(RES_H.iR.G),rownames(RES_iR.nR.G))
RN.t<-table(RN)
RN.t<-RN.t[RN.t==3]

RES_H.nR.G.sel<-RES_H.nR.G[names(RN.t),]
RES_H.iR.G.sel<-RES_H.iR.G[names(RN.t),]
RES_iR.nR.G.sel<-RES_iR.nR.G[names(RN.t),]

rownames(RES_H.nR.G.sel)==rownames(RES_H.iR.G.sel)

plot(RES_H.nR.G.sel$log2FoldChange,RES_H.iR.G.sel$log2FoldChange)
plot(RES_H.nR.G.sel$log2FoldChange,RES_iR.nR.G.sel$log2FoldChange)
cor.test(RES_H.nR.G.sel$log2FoldChange,RES_iR.nR.G.sel$log2FoldChange,method = "spearman")
cor.test(RES_H.nR.G.sel$log2FoldChange,RES_H.iR.G.sel$log2FoldChange,method = "spearman")
  

```

# dbRDA  for Hydromys species

```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=8}

# prepare data.frame for analyses
ORD.df$Species2<-ORD.df$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others
ORD.df$Species2<-gsub(" ",".",ORD.df$Species2)

# Cophenetic phylogenetic distances + select relevant axes 
PHYLO.coph<-cophenetic(HYDRO.p.unq.u)
PHYLO.coph.m<-pcoa(PHYLO.coph)
PHYLO.coph.m$values #First 5 axes exceed broken stick 

PHYLO.coph.df<-data.frame(PHYLO.coph.m$vectors)
NAMES<-colnames(as.matrix(Bray))
NAMES<-gsub(" ",".",NAMES)
PHYLO.coph.df<-PHYLO.coph.df[NAMES,]
#rownames(PHYLO.coph.df)==NAMES

# Null model vs Full + forward selection of relevant axes
# all 5 axes significant 
rda_null <- dbrda(Bray ~ 1, data = PHYLO.coph.df[,1:5])
rda_full <- dbrda(Bray ~ ., data = PHYLO.coph.df[,1:5])
rda_selected <- ordiR2step(rda_null, scope = formula(rda_full), trace = F)
anova(rda_selected , by="margin") 
summary(rda_selected)


#####Data frame for analyses#####
nperm=999
#ORD.df$Species2==rownames(PHYLO.coph.df)
ORD.df.2<-data.frame(ORD.df,PHYLO.coph.df[,1:5])


####Models for Bray-Curtis
a.bc.nf<-dbrda(Bray ~ Diet+Strata+Body_mass, data = ORD.df.2) #non-phylogenetic model
a.bc.f<-dbrda(Bray ~ Condition(Axis.1+Axis.2+Axis.3+Axis.4+Axis.5)+
                Diet+Strata+Body_mass, data = ORD.df.2) # phylogenetic model


# Table for phylogeny (based on model comparission)
tab_comp <- as.data.frame(anova(a.bc.nf, a.bc.f, permutations = nperm))
comp_row <- tab_comp[nrow(tab_comp), , drop = FALSE]

# Table for other predictors (after control for phylogeny - marginal testing)
joint_result <- data.frame(
  Term = "Phylogeny",
  Df = as.numeric(comp_row[["Df"]]),
  F = as.numeric(comp_row[["F"]]),
  P = as.numeric(comp_row[["Pr(>F)"]]),
  R2_effect = as.numeric(a.bc.f$pCCA$tot.chi / a.bc.f$tot.chi)
)

tab_margin <- as.data.frame(anova(a.bc.f, by = "margin", permutations = nperm))
total_inertia <- a.bc.f$tot.chi
unconditioned_inertia <- a.bc.f$CCA$tot.chi + a.bc.f$CA$tot.chi
tab_effects <- tab_margin[rownames(tab_margin) != "Residual", , drop = FALSE]

# 5. Build results table
marginal_results <- data.frame(
  Term = rownames(tab_effects),
  Df = as.numeric(tab_effects[["Df"]]),
  F = as.numeric(tab_effects[["F"]]),
  P = as.numeric(tab_effects[["Pr(>F)"]]),
  #SS = as.numeric(tab_effects[[ss_col]]),
  R2_effect = as.numeric(tab_effects[["SumOfSqs"]]) / total_inertia,
  #R2_unconditioned = as.numeric(tab_effects[[ss_col]]) / unconditioned_inertia,
  row.names = NULL
)

results <- rbind(joint_result, marginal_results)
results.bc.f<-results

# table for non-phylogenetic model
tab_margin.nf <- as.data.frame(anova(a.bc.nf, by = "margin", permutations = nperm))
tab_margin.nf <- tab_margin.nf[rownames(tab_margin.nf) != "Residual",, drop = FALSE]
total_inertia <- a.bc.nf$tot.chi

marginal_results <- data.frame(
  Term = rownames(tab_margin.nf),
  Df = as.numeric(tab_margin.nf[["Df"]]),
  F = as.numeric(tab_margin.nf[["F"]]),
  P = as.numeric(tab_margin.nf[["Pr(>F)"]]),
  R2_effect = as.numeric(tab_margin.nf[["SumOfSqs"]]) / total_inertia,
  row.names = NULL
)

results.bc.nf<-rbind(c("Phylogeny","","","",""),
                    marginal_results)

#### Final table
DF.rda<-
data.frame(Response=c("Metagenomes","","",""),
           rbind(results.bc.nf),
           rbind(results.bc.f[,2:5]))

write.table(DF.rda, file="results/RDA_table_Picrust.txt",
            sep="\t",row.names = F, quote = F)
DF.rda
```

# LinDA - differential abundance analysis for Hydromys species

```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=8}

#phyloseg
PHS.pic_path
taxa_table<-data.frame(otu_table(PHS.pic_path))
rownames(taxa_table)<-as.character(tax_table(PHS.pic_path)[,2])
metadata<-data.frame(sample_data(PHS.pic_path))

class(taxa_table)<-"data.frame"
class(metadata)<-"data.frame"

metadata$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others<-as.factor(metadata$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others)
metadata$Body_mass
metadata$Alt.Z<-scale(metadata$Alt)
metadata$Body_mass.Z<-scale(metadata$Body_mass)
metadata$Metalokalita[metadata$Metalokalita%in%c("Nagada","Wanang","Baitabag")]<-"Mt_Wilhelm"
metadata$Diet<-factor(metadata$Diet,levels=c("herbivore","omnivore","carnivore"))

Linda_iR.nR.G<-
  linda(
    feature.dat=(as.matrix(taxa_table)),
    meta.dat=metadata,
    formula="~Run+Metalokalita+Body_mass.Z+Strata+Alt.Z+Diet+
    (1|Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others)+(1|Locality)",
    feature.dat.type = c('count', 'proportion'),
    prev.filter = 0.1,
    mean.abund.filter = 0, 
    max.abund.filter = 0,
    is.winsor = FALSE,
    outlier.pct = 0.03,
    adaptive = TRUE,
    zero.handling = c('pseudo-count', 'imputation'),
    pseudo.cnt = 0.5,
    corr.cut = 0.1,
    p.adj.method = "BH",
    alpha = 0.05,
    n.cores = 1, 
    verbose = TRUE
  )

##results###
Linda_long<-function(LINDA){
  long_results <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(LINDA$output), function(varname) {
    df <- as.data.frame(LINDA$output[[varname]])
    # ensure taxa are a column (rownames in output correspond to taxa)
    df$taxon <- rownames(df)
    df$variable <- varname
    # keep columns you want; adjust/select more if desired
    df %>% dplyr::select(taxon, variable, baseMean, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, stat, pvalue, padj, reject, df)
  }),
  .id = NULL
) %>%
  arrange(taxon, variable)
long_results
} 

Linda_res<-Linda_long(LINDA=Linda_iR.nR.G)
Linda_res<-Linda_res[grep("^Run",Linda_res$variable,invert = T),]

tapply(Linda_res$pvalue<0.05,Linda_res$variable,sum)

SELECT<-unique(Linda_res$taxon[Linda_res$padj<0.05])

Linda_res_SIG<-Linda_res[Linda_res$taxon%in%SELECT,]
SIG_MAT<-Linda_res_SIG[,c("taxon","variable","padj")]
EFF_MAT<-Linda_res_SIG[,c("taxon","variable","log2FoldChange")]
SIG_MAT.w<-reshape(SIG_MAT, idvar = "taxon", timevar = "variable", direction = "wide")
EFF_MAT.w<-reshape(EFF_MAT, idvar = "taxon", timevar = "variable", direction = "wide")
rownames(SIG_MAT.w)<-SIG_MAT.w$taxon
rownames(EFF_MAT.w)<-EFF_MAT.w$taxon

EFF_MAT.w<-EFF_MAT.w[,2:dim(EFF_MAT.w)[2]]
SIG_MAT.w<-SIG_MAT.w[,2:dim(SIG_MAT.w)[2]]
EFF_MAT.w[SIG_MAT.w>0.05]<-0

EFF_MAT.w.eff<-EFF_MAT.w
EFF_MAT.w.eff[abs(EFF_MAT.w.eff)<2]<-0
colSums(EFF_MAT.w.eff!=0)
colSums(EFF_MAT.w!=0)

colnames(EFF_MAT.w)<-gsub("log2FoldChange.","",colnames(EFF_MAT.w))
colnames(EFF_MAT.w.eff)<-gsub("log2FoldChange.","",colnames(EFF_MAT.w))

EFF_MAT.w.eff<-EFF_MAT.w.eff[rowSums(abs(EFF_MAT.w.eff))!=0,]
dim(EFF_MAT.w.eff)

library(circlize)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(min(as.matrix(EFF_MAT.w.eff)), 0, max(as.matrix(EFF_MAT.w.eff))),    # value breaks
  c("blue","grey80", "red")    # corresponding colors
)

colnames(EFF_MAT.w.eff)<-c("Elevation", "Body mass", "Herbivores x Carnivores", "Herbivores x Omnivore" ," Finisterres x Mt. Wilhelm","Scansorial x Terrestrial")

colnames(EFF_MAT.w)<-c("Elevation", "Body mass", "Herbivores x Carnivores", "Herbivores x Omnivore" ," Finisterres x Mt. Wilhelm","Scansorial x Terrestrial")

# only pathways with |l2fc| > 2 reretained
pdf(file = "results/Hydro_Linda_pic_lfc2.pdf", width=18/2.54, height=17/2.54)
  ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(as.matrix(EFF_MAT.w.eff),
                          cluster_columns = FALSE,
                          column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
                          row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
                          col = col_fun,
                          row_names_max_width = unit(10, "cm"),
                          heatmap_legend_param = list(title = NULL,
                                                      legend_direction = "horizontal",
                                                      labels_gp=gpar(fontsize = 6))) |>

dev.off()
```
